abstract: Approximately 30% of patients with disseminated testicular cancer who receive platinum-based chemotherapy will experience normalization of tumor markers but have persistent, radiographically evident disease in the retroperitoneum. These patients are usually subjected to retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection (RPLND). In all, 45 of 557 patients (8.1%) undergoing postchemotherapy RPLND at Indiana University Medical Center (IUMC) were found to have neoplastic elements distinct from the classic germ-cell tumor types within their resected specimens. Examples included various sarcomas in 14 patients (3.7%), other nonsarcomatous non-germ-cell cancers in 18 patients (3.2%), and cystic atypical choriocarcinoma in 8 patients (1.4%). No distinct patient characteristic or histologic pattern in the primary tumor was predictive of these unusual findings in the RPLND specimen, although sampling error in the orchiectomy specimen could be the reason for this lack of correlation. Surgical resection of these chemoresistant tumors is potentially curative, with disease-free survival being obtained in 13 of 19 patients (68.4%) with sarcoma, 10 of 18 patients (55.6%) with nonsarcomatous cancers, and 7 of 8 patients (87.5%) with cystic atypical choriocarcinoma at mean follow-up intervals of 30.6, 42.5, and 24.7 months, respectively.
abstract_ja: インディアナ大学医療センター（IUMC）で化学療法後RPLNDを受けた557例のうち、45例（8.1%）で切除標本に古典的な胚細胞腫瘍の組織型とは異なる腫瘍成分が認められた。その内訳は、肉腫が14例（3.7%）、その他の非肉腫性・非胚細胞性癌が18例（3.2%）、嚢胞性非定型絨毛癌が8例（1.4%）であった。原発腫瘍の特定の臨床的特徴や組織学的パターンは、これらの非典型的所見を予測しなかったが、精巣摘除術標本のサンプリング誤差がこの相関の欠如の理由である可能性がある。これらの化学療法抵抗性腫瘍に対する外科的切除は根治の可能性があり、平均追跡期間はそれぞれ30.6か月、42.5か月、24.7か月で、肉腫19例中13例（68.4%）、非肉腫性癌18例中10例（55.6%）、嚢胞性非定型絨毛癌8例中7例（87.5%）で無病生存が得られた。
